versions.changelog: Lite concept version - full implementation on ClawDex

Version 2.1.2 of brand-marketing-workflow is a documentation-only update that replaces the previous executable implementation with a structural reference.

- Removes implementation details and executable content; now contains only system architecture and workflow documentation.
- Clearly outlines workflow layers: input, planning, production, analysis, authorization, and output.
- Explicitly defines policy boundaries, allowed actions, and disallowed behaviors.
- Provides guidance for safe reference use when withdrawing the functional skill from active deployment.
- Suggests a future redesign as a spec-first, approval-gated skill without runtime logic.

No changes detected in this version.  
- Version 2.1.1 release: No file or documentation updates.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

Brand-marketing-workflow 2.1.0

- Major upgrade: Migrated from document-only reference to a fully executable, multi-platform brand marketing workflow.
- Added end-to-end modules for input normalization, content production, competitor analysis, authorization, and LLM integration.
- Introduced parallel execution, TTL caching, exponential backoff, and risk-based authorization logic for efficiency and compliance.
- Provided detailed configuration guide, input schema, and quick start instructions.
- Refreshed project structure and files to enable live demos, extensibility, and integrated testing.
- MIT licensed; supports multi-channel (XiaoHongShu, Weibo, Douyin) content generation.
Replace active implementation with documentation-only structural reference
